entries.zh: 看山人：为坟墓看风水选地者（堪舆师）；巫师（西语 agorero＝占卜者、hechicero＝行巫术者）
entries.en: geomancer who inspects sites for graves; sorcerer/diviner (Sp. agorero, hechicero)

entries.zh: 七月（汉、闽、官三栏均作七月；西语词头 Agosto 本义为八月，此处按农历七月对音）
entries.en: seventh month (July); Sp. Agosto 'August' aligned with lunar seventh month
entries.notes: 西历八月与农历七月纪月体系不同，以汉栏为准。

entries.en: to please, to suit one's liking; to hit the mark
entries.notes: 单字“中”需依后条“中意”组合推释义。

entries.en: to be pleased with; to like, to suit one's taste

entries.zh: 中主意：正中己意、称心如意（所言所行恰合其心意）
entries.en: to hit exactly upon one's mind; to be exactly to one's liking

entries.zh: 中意：合意、喜爱（同前条，异音写 tióng ỳ）
报答：回报、酬谢（感谢并回报恩惠）
entries.en: to repay; to requite, to recompense a favor

entries.zh: 报以：报谢、报答（以礼相报）〔原件字形存疑〕
entries.en: to repay, to render thanks in return
entries.notes: 汉栏“報供”与音写 pò ý / pōu yǐ 未完全对应，释义据词头 agradecer 推定。

entries.en: to repay a kindness; to return a favor

entries.zh: 报义：以义相报、报答恩义
entries.en: to requite according to righteousness; to repay moral debt
entries.notes: “报义”为词典化组合，释义由报+义字面推定。

entries.zh: 报恩义：报答恩德与情义（知恩报义）
entries.en: to repay kindness and righteousness; gratitude in both favor and duty

entries.zh: 报恩豪：报恩德〔字形存疑，疑为“报恩德”之异写或误录〕
entries.en: to repay kindness (probably for 報恩德 'repay virtue/kindness')
entries.notes: 汉栏“豪”与音写 têg/官话 te 不对应，疑为德字之误。

entries.en: to repay kindness and virtue received
entries.notes: 官话对音栏（iēn guī xīn）与汉栏不对应，疑串行，据汉闽两栏定释义。

entries.zh: 有义人：有情有义之人、感恩图报的人
entries.en: a grateful man; a man of gratitude and righteousness (Sp. agradecido)
entries.notes: 官话栏误接他行（同前条），据汉闽两栏释义。

entries.zh: 承惠：承领惠赠、感谢所赠之物（谢礼套语）
entries.en: to receive a gift with thanks; to acknowledge a present
to receive favor/kindness; to be indebted to another's grace

entries.zh: 仁义：恩义、情义（感恩重义之心）〔汉栏作仁義，音写近心義〕
entries.en: benevolence and righteousness; gratitude and sense of obligation
entries.notes: 汉栏“仁義”与音写 xīn gỹ（心義）有出入，据词头 agradecimiento 释义为感恩之义。

entries.zh: 人情：感恩之情、情分（受人恩惠所负之情）
entries.en: gratitude; favor owed, sense of obligation (renqing)
entries.notes: 音写 xīn chêng 近“心情”，汉栏作人情，取人情义。

entries.zh: 认恩人：知恩之人、感恩图报者
entries.en: a man who acknowledges kindness; a grateful person
entries.notes: 官话栏末字 xin 疑衍（当为 rén），据汉闽两栏释义。
